claims.claim: This is a 'Dirt 4 Shockwave Sport' bicycle (brand/model)
claims.evidence: Witness notes a logo/text on frame but it is not legible; no brand or model confirmed.
Witness only reports a front suspension fork; no rear shock or rear suspension linkage is mentioned or visible.
Only a front disc brake is confirmed by the witness; rear wheel brake type is not described.
Witness confirms a multiple gear/derailleur setup at the rear wheel.

risks.risk: Rear suspension may not exist (hardtail, not full-suspension)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rear frame triangle showing presence or absence of a rear shock

risks.risk: Rear brake may be a cheaper rim/V-brake instead of disc
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear wheel hub/brake area
risks.if_unproven: priced as single (front-only) disc brake setup

risks.risk: Gear and brake functionality unknown (rust, slipping gears, worn pads)
risks.proof: Short video of pedaling through gears and braking test

risks.risk: Frame/fork material and overall build quality (generic vs branded) unclear due to illegible logo
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo of the frame decal/logo and serial number

risks.risk: Tire and tube condition, possible dry rot or punctures
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires including tread and sidewalls

risks.risk: Hidden frame damage, dents, rust, or bent parts not visible from the single angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles including underside and joints
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural condition unknown, worst case moderate damage

risks.risk: Frame size/fit for intended rider unknown
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure on frame or rider standing beside bike
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard/average size, fit not guaranteed

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit photo of the frame logo/decal and any serial number
Close-up photo of the rear wheel area showing brake type (disc vs rim)
Photo or short video showing the rear frame to confirm presence/absence of rear suspension
Video of the bike being pedaled through all gears and both brakes being applied
Close-up photos of both tires and frame joints/welds for wear or rust
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a mountain-style bicycle with a visible front suspension fork, front disc brake, and gear system, so it can be priced at worst case as a single-suspension, single-confirmed-disc-brake bike with unverified brand, condition, and rear specs pending further proof.
